title: Perceptual dissolve model: why the image is not seen closer than about 1.8 m

constant.value: CSF-weighted band contrast of h at the viewing distance (Mannos-Sakrison CSF, Peli band contrast), calibrated so detection crosses 50 % at 1.8 m

luminance.rule: Y = Y_linen * (1 - a*h), exact for the JJE model (linear in h)

peak_sensitivity.from: 1 / (1 - 10^-0.004): the measured threshold read as the CSF peak

bands.method: Gaussian stack on h (large sigmas filtered on block-averaged copies), band k = G(sigma_k) - G(sigma_k+1), local contrast c_k = a*band_k / (1 - a*G(sigma_k+1)) (Peli 1990); 99th percentile over the body region

visibility: v_k(d) = c_k * S_peak * S(f_deg) / S(peak); V(d) = max_k v_k; detection P = 1 - 2^(-(V*cal)^3.5)

prediction.note: Where the uncalibrated model crosses threshold, using only the measured threshold, the standard CSF and the synthetic image. It is a consistency check, not a measurement.

calibration.note: Multiplies the sensitivity so detection crosses 50 % at 1.8 m (one measured point).

renderer_gain.formula: g_k = v^3 / (1 + v^3) with v = c_k(x) * S_peak * cal * S(f_deg) / S(peak)
renderer_gain.use: h_seen = G(sigma_K) + sum_k g_k * band_k, per fragment; the X_ITE shader and the LOD textures use the same formula

lod_textures.note: Perceived albedo (D65) at each distance, 2x downsampled, for X3D LOD nodes; and h_seen, the perceived h before the colour lookup, for renderers that apply the LUT themselves (Blender).
